First, notice that the numbers $1$ and $64$ are both perfect cubes. 

So, to determine the value of $\sqrt[3]{\dfrac{1}{64}},$ we express $\dfrac{1}{64}$ as a perfect cube:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{64}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{{1}^{3}}{{4}^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{1\cdot 1\cdot 1}{4\cdot 4\cdot 4}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{4}\cdot \frac{1}{4}\cdot \frac{1}{4}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(\frac{1}{4})}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
